label: Measured on the PayPal sandbox on 2026-11-12. Not re-run now: these are recorded results, the ids are the sandbox's own.
source: VERIFY.md, Sandbox results (scripts/verify-sandbox.js V4, V5, V8, scripts/sdk-smoke.js V11, scripts/sandbox-contract.js V5b, scripts/record-v1.js V1 on the deployed host)

items.claim: Real PayPal sandbox deliveries reach the deployed EchoBench and are recorded with their PAYPAL-* headers
items.evidence: Recording rec_mwdhuanv213fd5 on https://echobench.35-216-2-121.sslip.io (sandbox mode, webhook 7DN129377S414341L). Order 3RE32161SC8633459, capture 4PF24653JV1088034 (12.00), refunds 4.00 and 8.00 from MugShop's admin route. Four deliveries, each with PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-ID/-SIG and cert_url on api.sandbox.paypal.com: CHECKOUT.ORDER.APPROVED WH-03M836374A321061A-9YH27962VR649240K, PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED WH-1E728186RK2013307-0RP58738CT935322S, PAYMENT.CAPTURE.REFUNDED WH-8EH49998UT383121R-9ST02389V5578644J and WH-33E87674C80765127-5PG46551WY547335C. MugShop verified and answered 200 to each. Start points SP0 to SP3 taken.

items.claim: Shake all on that real recording (PayPal's records read from the sandbox)
items.evidence: MugShop (planted bugs): S0 to S4 red (shipped 2 times), S5 red (PayPal 12.00 refunded, shop 4.00), S5b red (PayPal 12.00 in 2 refunds, shop 8.00 in 1), S6 green (2 forged events rejected), S7 red, D1 na (no dispute in this recording). MugShop (reference fix): S0 to S6 green, S7 amber, D1 na. Same verdicts as on the stand-in recording. The recorded S1 patch (Claude Sonnet, 2026-11-12) re-run on this recording: S1 green, but S3 and S4 red (order status CREATED, expected CAPTURED), so EchoBench marks it not verified; on the stand-in recording it passed.

items.claim: The SDK read equals the plain REST read of the same real order
items.evidence: same: true. Order 5P708734V2966923V, capture 39101844PY640523P, COMPLETED, 12.00. client.orders.getOrder and GET /v2/checkout/orders/{id} gave the same normalized order.

items.claim: MugShop's capture through the SDK returns the captures (Prefer: return=representation)
items.evidence: Order 8Y281151LE2041832 captured through the SDK path. The reply carried purchase_units[].payments.captures, capture 5X970784R08289842.

items.claim: Found: captureOrder with no body is answered 415
items.evidence: The SDK map lists the captureOrder body as optional and then sends no Content-Type header. The sandbox answered 415 UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE. Passing body {} fixes it (targets/mugshop/src/paypalSdk.ts, test/sdk-adapter.test.js).

items.claim: The same PayPal-Request-Id returns the same refund and creates no second one
items.evidence: Capture 5X970784R08289842, refund 52676734MU2400949 returned 201. The repeat with the same PayPal-Request-Id returned 200 with the same refund id. Refunds on the order: 1.

items.claim: A real contract payment recorded for Contract tab runs
items.evidence: Order 8Y281151LE2041832, capture 5X970784R08289842, 12.00. V5 then refunded 4.00 of it.

items.claim: SDK smoke: reads work with the sandbox credential and a 404 decodes as a PayPal error
items.evidence: getOrder ok (COMPLETED, 12.00), getCapturedPayment ok (COMPLETED), a made-up order id gave a typed 404 decoded through the SDK Error model, OAuth token request ok. No 403 on any operation.

items.claim: C-UNK on MugShop (reference fix): refund sent through the proxy, PayPal's reply cut
items.evidence: GREEN: The reply was cut; the app re-sent the same PayPal-Request-Id and settled with one refund. Order 6NY987535G7169516, capture 4VF768579P901433T, refunds at PayPal: 8DH51725TN890892T 4.00. Refund calls seen by the proxy: 201 (reply cut) id 30adbb69; 200 id 30adbb69.

items.claim: C-UNK on MugShop (contract removed, contrast): refund sent through the proxy, PayPal's reply cut
items.evidence: RED: PayPal refunded but the reply was cut: it reported the refund as failed; PayPal refunds 1, the shop books 0. Order 5DW328583D433311P, capture 25V12368MD2316333, refunds at PayPal: 98G44114MT935673U 4.00. Refund calls seen by the proxy: 201 (reply cut) id 60ccef91.

items.claim: C-DUP (first version, both requests at the same moment) on MugShop (contract removed, contrast)
items.evidence: GREEN: Two simultaneous refund requests became one PayPal refund. Order 0MX82598V4705481S, capture 15977184649549306, refunds at PayPal: 9S489640RY763513K 4.00. Refund calls seen by the proxy: 409 id cfa083f7; 201 id 89de04e1. PayPal itself answered the overlapping second request 409 PREVIOUS_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS, so C-DUP now sends the two requests one after the other (the local stand-in copies the 409).

items.claim: C-DUP on MugShop (reference fix): the same 4.00 refund from the admin page, then from the support desk
items.evidence: GREEN: The same refund from two code paths became one PayPal refund. Order 8YY02244S83835501, capture 1D473549NR724120R, refunds at PayPal: 3R834948FC525115M 4.00. Refund calls seen by the proxy: 201 id 21f12903.

items.claim: C-DUP on MugShop (contract removed, contrast): the same 4.00 refund from the admin page, then from the support desk
items.evidence: RED: PayPal refunds: 2 for one request, the shop books 2. Order 8M9957751S5797610, capture 0J959859A6639224B, refunds at PayPal: 0YV80846AW8891156 4.00, 2TE88129DT787735B 4.00. Refund calls seen by the proxy: 201 id f3aee54e; 201 id 607d0a46.
